raw_segments.text: He threw his arms up. We were on deck at the time, and the head man of my woodcutters,
lounging nearby, turned upon him his heavy and glittering eyes. I looked around, and
I don't know why, but I assure you that never, never before did this land. This river, this
jungle, the very arch of this blazing sky, appear to me so hopeless and so dark, so impenetrable
to human thought, so pitiless to human weakness.
And ever since you have been with him, of course, I said.
